**Read** — interactive articles that explain a spatial problem
properly, with runnable Python and R examples built in, not just
diagrams. [Explore the articles →](/articles.html)

**Use** — free standalone tools for the same checks, when you just
need an answer, not the full explanation. [Explore the tools →](/tools/index.html)

## Spatial Data Quality

A small, focused toolkit for checking geospatial data before you trust
it. Free, no account, nothing leaves your browser.

**Tools** — [Inspect](/tools/geospatial-file-inspector.html) ·
[Validate](/tools/geojson-shapefile-validator.html) ·
[Check Topology](/tools/topology-checker.html) ·
[CRS](/tools/crs-inspector.html)

## Raster

Reading a GeoTIFF's dimensions, bands, CRS, and NoData, then computing
with it — combining two bands into a colored result, including a
vegetation-specific NDVI map, and modeling what's visible from a
point given the terrain in between.

**Tools** — [Inspect](/tools/raster-inspector.html) →
[Calculate](/tools/raster-calculator.html) →
[NDVI](/tools/ndvi-calculator.html) →
[Viewshed](/tools/viewshed-calculator.html)

**Articles** — [Inspect](/posts/raster-file-inspection.html) →
[Calculate](/posts/raster-band-math.html) →
[NDVI](/posts/raster-ndvi.html) →
[Viewshed](/posts/raster-viewshed.html)

## GeoML

Machine learning on spatial data, starting with unsupervised
clustering — runnable Python and R code side by side, including where
the two languages disagree on something as basic as how a result is
labeled.

**Tools** — [Cluster](/tools/spatial-clustering-explorer.html)

**Articles** — [Cluster](/posts/spatial-clustering.html)
